item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.0
item.description: - Everything in one panel: click the menu bar icon for On/Off, your paste history and all settings. No more separate windows. - Right-click the icon for About, updates, the website, feedback and Quit. - Choose your own paste shortcut (Shortcut → Custom…), and exclude apps where pastes should never change. Markdown headings now always come in as bold text. - Email apps: if ConformTXT can't read your text size (say, right after the app reopens), it uses the last size it saw there instead of the app's large default. - A new app icon and menu bar icon: an outlined ⌘V key. - A crisper look: near-black wordmark, switches and links, a snugger .txt box, and the icon's lime now matches the app's. - Every paste matches, including pastes within the same app or document. - Code stays code: code blocks keep their lines and indents, in a monospace font. - Safer font checks: only in real text fields, never in spreadsheets or presentations, and nothing is ever deleted unless ConformTXT is sure it's its own. - Slow apps: your clipboard goes back only after the app has taken the paste. - Pastes made by TextExpander, Raycast, Alfred or Keyboard Maestro, and pastes into Spotlight or the emoji picker, are left alone. - Emoji pictures from Gmail, Slack and X come through as emoji, and a copied image pastes as usual. - Cleaner tables and Gmail replies, and turning Accessibility access off and on works without restarting.
